name: together without a middleman
headline: Together, without a *middleman*
say: Reason six: being together, without a middleman. Open a swarm, and the people in the room share tiles live. Take what you like, and it lands in your own hive. When people leave, their tiles leave with them. When you want something to stay, publish it to a host. Either way, two hives exchange work directly, by signature. No accounts to reconcile, and no feed deciding what you see.
